threads.body: The `desc` still says “percentage”, but the metric is now normalized to a unitless fraction (`unit: \"1\"`). Update the description to reflect the new semantics (e.g., “The fraction (0..1) of non-persistent storage used by this destination”) to avoid misleading metric consumers.
threads.hunk:
@@ -37,6 +37,7 @@ rules:
       # activemq.destination.temp.utilization
       TempUsagePercentUsage:
         metric: destination.temp.utilization
+        sourceUnit: "%"
         unit: "1"
         type: gauge
         desc: The percentage of non-persistent storage used by this destination

replies.body: fixed in 2c889bd, changing metric descriptions is not considered to be a breaking change.

threads.body: The changelog entry says the new range is “between 0 and 1”, while the PR description/migration notes specify “between 0 and 1.0 (inclusive)”. Consider aligning the wording (and explicitly stating inclusivity) to avoid ambiguity. Also remove the trailing whitespace at the end of line 7.
